formal_reference: Protected Gold under tests/_data/gold/: one public reference request plus four off-grid private probes produced by the frozen case-005 Poisson-Fermi solver.

host_replay.oracle: reward 1 for the frozen reference solver against the current Gold and verifier (fixed-image replay)
host_replay.adversarial: documented negative set rejected, including a solver.py symlinked to private Gold

notes: Gold is protected mode 0700 with files mode 0600; the verifier imports it with bytecode writing disabled.
The verifier stages the declared /app/final outputs and accepts a self-contained solver plus regular .py helpers inside final/.
Near-wall rough averages use direct continuous-BVP composite Gauss panels through 30 A; the far tail uses one-sided FFT convolution with trapezoidal endpoint corrections.
The PDE residual verifier covers the fourth interior sample through the fourth-from-last; endpoint stencils are not independently PDE-scored.
The finite-dimensional polarization stability diagnostic is author-side evidence and does not prove global minimality.
